methods.name: Dual Decoders
methods.description: Illustration of the dual decoders for panoptic segmentation and depth estimation. Each decoder takes in its own query embeddings and performs masked cross-attention with image features from the Transformer encoder, where masks are generated from the previous decoder output. A subsequent cross-decoder query association layer enables the communication between segment and depth queries belonging to the same segment, followed by a typical self-attention layer.
